caption: One condition, paired with one or more field-level actions.

titlePlain: What a UI Policy Action can

steps.label: Visible
steps.sub: show or hide the field entirely

steps.label: Mandatory
steps.sub: require it before the form can submit

steps.label: Read-only
steps.sub: display it but block typing into it

code:
Form submit (browser)........... UI Policy fires
Background script............... UI Policy never fires
Import Set load.................. UI Policy never fires
Scripted REST API write......... UI Policy never fires
caption: UI Policies only govern the rendered form — nothing else.
